# Amplitude Documentation

> Official documentation for Amplitude digital analytics, data management, experimentation, activation, and AI products.

Use Docs MCP for targeted, read-only public documentation retrieval. Authenticated Amplitude MCP reads or changes product data according to the user's account permissions.
Prefer current SDKs for new implementations. Verify plan requirements, lifecycle status, and availability on the linked live page before making recommendations.
Use Docs MCP or `/docs/api/content/<slug>` for targeted retrieval. Use product-partitioned feeds or `llms-full.txt` for offline corpus access.

## Agent Instructions

- **Current SDKs (prefer these):** Browser Unified SDK (`sdks/analytics/browser/browser-unified-sdk/get-started`), Python SDK (`sdks/analytics/python/python-sdk`), iOS Swift SDK (`sdks/analytics/ios/ios-swift-sdk/get-started`), Android Kotlin SDK (`sdks/analytics/android/android-kotlin-sdk/get-started`). Use Browser SDK 2 (`sdks/analytics/browser/browser-sdk-2/get-started`) for analytics-only browser implementations. Avoid legacy or maintenance SDK pages unless the user asks about migration.
- **Current API (HTTP API v2):** `apis/analytics/http-v2` and `apis/analytics/http-api-quickstart`. Do not recommend deprecated legacy ingestion endpoints.
- **Migration guides:** `migration/migrate-from-segment`, `migration/migrate-from-mixpanel`, `migration/migrate-from-adobe`, `migration/migrate-from-mparticle`, `migration/migrate-from-google-analytics`.
- **Product-partitioned feeds:** Prefer `llms-analytics.txt`, `llms-data.txt`, `llms-experiment.txt`, `llms-session-replay.txt`, or `llms-guides-surveys.txt` over HTML hub pages. Each feed stays under 150K tokens.
- **Deprecated surfaces:** Skip pages marked legacy or deprecated in this index. Verify lifecycle status on the linked live page before recommending APIs or SDKs.

## Start here

- [What is Amplitude?](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/get-started/what-is-amplitude): Amplitude is an AI analytics platform that tracks user actions and turns them into engagement, retention, and revenue insights.
- [Get Started](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/get-started): Get Amplitude running in your app. Answer a few questions to find your install guide, then start with the tasks for your role.
- [Quickstart for product managers and analysts](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/get-started/quickstart-for-product-teams): Build a Metric Explorer chart, save a user cohort, and share a dashboard. The first three tasks for product managers, analysts, and UX researchers in Amplitude.
- [Quickstart for engineers](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/get-started/quickstart-for-engineers): Instrument your product with Amplitude, set up Autocapture, and identify your users as an engineer.
- [Quickstart for growth and marketing teams](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/get-started/quickstart-for-growth-teams): Launch a web experiment, add in-product guides and surveys, and use Session Replay to diagnose conversion drop-off as a growth or marketing practitioner.
- [Quickstart for data teams](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/get-started/quickstart-for-data-teams): Set up a tracking plan, validate incoming events, and establish data governance as a data engineer or implementation lead.

## Choose Amplitude by goal

- [Analytics](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics): Answer product questions with charts, cohorts, and dashboards, no SQL required. Explore chart types, group users into cohorts, build dashboards, and collaborate on findings.
- [Data](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data): Send data into Amplitude, organize and clean it, and activate it across your downstream tools.
- [Session Replay](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/session-replay): Session Replay records and plays back user web and mobile sessions synced with the event stream, so you can see exactly what a user did at each event.
- [Heatmaps](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/heatmaps): Use Heatmaps to visualize where users click, interact, and scroll, and turn engagement into events, replays, and cohorts.
- [Guides and Surveys](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/guides-and-surveys): Build in-product guides, surveys, and themes to drive feature adoption and gather feedback.
- [Feature Experiment](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/feature-experiment): Test, analyze, and ship feature flags and experiments at scale across web, mobile, and backend.
- [Web Experiment](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/web-experiment): Run no-code experiments on your website with a visual editor and built-in analytics. Test ideas faster, target the right visitors, and prove what actually drives conversions.
- [Amplitude AI](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai): Get answers, dashboards, and replay analysis from agents that work alongside your team — and see how your brand shows up in the LLM answers your customers are reading.
- [AI Assistant](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/assistant): Embed an in-product AI assistant that answers user questions and launches in-app guides.

## Agent access

- [Docs MCP server](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai/docs-mcp-server): Connect AI clients to the public Amplitude docs MCP endpoint.
- [Amplitude MCP Server](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai/amplitude-mcp): Connect the Amplitude MCP server to AI tools so teams can query and create Amplitude content with natural language.

## Build with Amplitude

- [Amplitude Analytics SDK Catalog](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/sdks/analytics): Browse the catalog of Amplitude Analytics SDKs by platform, with links to installation steps and reference documentation for each SDK.
- [Get started with the Browser Unified SDK](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/sdks/analytics/browser/browser-unified-sdk/get-started): Install the Amplitude Browser Unified SDK, initialize Analytics, Session Replay, Feature Experiment, and Guides and Surveys with one call, and send a first event.
- [HTTP V2 API](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/apis/analytics/http-v2): Send data directly from your server to the HTTP V2 endpoint.
- [Batch and retry HTTP V2 API requests](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/apis/analytics/http-api-batching-retries): Batch events, retry failed requests with backoff, and handle partial failures in the HTTP V2 API.

## User Management API

- [APIs](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/apis/index): Use Amplitude's REST APIs to ingest data, query analytics, and manage Amplitude programmatically.
- [List roles](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/apis/user-management/roles/list-roles): Returns a paginated list of role definitions for the caller's organization. Role responses omit permission actions.
- [Get role](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/apis/user-management/roles/get-role): Returns a single role definition by role uuid. The response omits permission actions.

## Get Started

- [Install Amplitude on a website with a script snippet](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/get-started/install-with-snippet): Add the Amplitude Browser SDK to any website with one script tag in the page head, with Autocapture, Session Replay, and remote config turned on.
- [Install the Browser Unified SDK with npm or yarn](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/get-started/install-with-package-manager): Install the Amplitude Browser Unified SDK in a bundled JavaScript app with npm or yarn, initialize it, and track your first event.
- [Set up Amplitude with an AI coding assistant](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/get-started/install-with-ai-prompt): Copy a prompt into Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or another AI coding tool to install and configure the Amplitude Browser SDK in a JavaScript web app.
- [Install an Amplitude mobile SDK](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/get-started/install-mobile-sdk): Install and initialize the Amplitude SDK for iOS, Android, React Native, or Flutter, then track your first event.
- [Install an Amplitude server SDK](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/get-started/install-server-sdk): Install and initialize the Amplitude SDK for Node.js or Python, then send your first event from your backend.
- [Quick guides](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/quick-guides): Short, watchable walkthroughs that take you from a blank screen to a working cohort, funnel, or experiment in Amplitude.
- [Build your first cohort](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/quick-guides/build-your-first-cohort): Group users by what they did or who they are, then reuse that list anywhere in Amplitude.
- [Build your first funnel](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/quick-guides/build-your-first-funnel): Find where users drop off by building a funnel with Global Agent.
- [Run your first experiment](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/quick-guides/run-your-first-experiment): Prove which product change drives results with a controlled A/B test in Amplitude Experiment.
- [Use Autocapture to get fast insights](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/get-started/autocapture): Enable Amplitude Autocapture to automatically collect page views, sessions, clicks, and form interactions from the Browser, iOS, Android, and Flutter SDKs with minimal setup.
- [Cross-platform instrumentation vs. separate platform instrumentation](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/get-started/cross-platform-vs-separate-platform): Decide whether to use one Amplitude API key across web, iOS, and Android or separate keys for each platform, based on how your apps and users behave.
- [Understand your users' activity](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/get-started/understand-user-activity): The User Activity Report template shows how often and how long users engage with your product, with charts for active users, sessions, and retention.

## Data

- [Common Patterns](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/common-patterns): Describes the four common ways Amplitude fits into a data stack: Amplitude alone, Amplitude with a CDP, Amplitude with a data warehouse, and Amplitude with both.
- [Plan your taxonomy](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/data-planning-playbook): Build a taxonomy in three steps: define your business objectives, break down key metrics, then optimize the resulting events and properties.
- [Getting set up with Amplitude Data](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/amplitude-data-get-started): Plan your taxonomy and naming conventions, choose an ingestion method, instrument, and validate against your plan before data reaches production.
- [Autocapture](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/autocapture): Autocapture is the fastest way to capture information about your website or app with minimal setup.
- [Event Discovery Agent](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/event-discovery-agent): Event Discovery Agent reviews your web Autocapture data each week and suggests labeled events for the key interactions in your product, for you to review. Status: Early Access.
- [IP address, location, user agent, and device properties](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/understand-ip-address-and-location): How Amplitude derives location properties from a user's IP address using the MaxMind GeoIP database, parses the user agent string for device and platform properties, and how to override or disable IP-based location.
- [Privacy and consent](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/privacy-and-consent-implementation): How consent models shape an Amplitude setup, what to decide before you configure anything, and which of the three implementation methods fits your policy.
- [Additional privacy considerations](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/privacy-and-consent-implementation/additional-considerations): Session Replay, access requests, privacy notices, data residency, post-launch caveats, server-side tracking, and Amplitude's position on modeled data.
- [Persisted Properties](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/persisted-properties): Persisted properties keep an event property's value, such as page path or campaign, attached to a user's later events for a set period so earlier context carries into downstream analysis.
- [Client-side vs Server-side](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/client-side-vs-server-side): Compare client-side, server-side, and third-party sources in Amplitude and learn when to use each for tracking events.
- [Destination event streaming overview](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/destination-event-streaming-overview): Stream Amplitude events to downstream tools, monitor delivery with Live Log and Debugger, and control what data each destination receives.
- [Express forwarding](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/express-forwarding): Forward raw events to Snowflake or Databricks every few minutes, so data is typically fresh within minutes. Status: Early Access.

## Charts

- [Metric Explorer](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/charts/metric-explorer/metric-explorer-build): Track events, sessions, revenue, and formulas over time in one chart, where each series has its own measurement, filters, group-bys, and smoothing.
- [Build an event segmentation analysis](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/charts/event-segmentation/event-segmentation-build): Use events and properties to create an Event Segmentation analysis
- [Build a funnel analysis](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/charts/funnel-analysis/funnel-analysis-build): Build your funnel analysis following Amplitude's best practices
- [Build a retention analysis](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/charts/retention-analysis/retention-analysis-build): Understand the purpose of the Retention Analysis chart and familiarize yourself with its interface
- [Attribute credit to multiple acquisition touch points](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/charts/data-tables/data-tables-attribute-credit): Understand how specific touch points are contributing to your marketing outcomes
- [Understand the paths users take, and why they convert](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/charts/journeys/journeys-understand-paths): Analyze conversions between the key transition points in your product
- [Dig deeper into experimentation data with Experiment Results](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/charts/experiment-results/experiment-results-dig-deeper): Extend the analytic power of A/B tests you create in Amplitude Experiment
- [Interpret your revenue analysis](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/charts/revenue-ltv/revenue-ltv-interpret): Identify the strengths and weaknesses of your approach to new-user monetization
- [The Compass chart: discover your users' 'a-ha' moments](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/charts/compass/compass-aha-moment): Build a Compass chart to identify user behaviors that best predict retention
- [The Personas chart: Find your product's user personas](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/charts/personas/personas-clustering): Build a cluster analysis of your product's users
- [Interpret your Impact Analysis chart](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/charts/impact-analysis/impact-analysis-interpret): Effectively and appropriately use causal inference to interpret your Impact Analysis
- [Interpret your Lifecycle chart](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/charts/lifecycle/lifecycle-interpret): Interpret the results of your Lifecycle chart

## User Solutions

- [Data Assistant user solutions](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/data-assistant-user-solutions): Step-by-step guides for data-quality problems Data Assistant can't detect or fix, written for people who don't code.
- [Missing User IDs after sign-in: confirm the problem](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/data-assistant-user-solutions/missing-user-ids-audit): Confirm by hand whether signed-in events are missing a stable User ID, then hand the fix to whoever owns your tracking.
- [User IDs set too early: confirm the problem](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/data-assistant-user-solutions/early-user-ids-audit): Confirm by hand whether a new anonymous visitor gets a User ID before your product actually knows who they are.
- [Anonymous activity lost at login: confirm the problem](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/data-assistant-user-solutions/login-identity-merge-audit): Confirm by hand whether anonymous activity and signed-in activity land in one profile after a person logs in.
- [One person, many User IDs: confirm the problem](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/data-assistant-user-solutions/multiple-user-ids-audit): Compare a person's real account record with their Amplitude profiles to confirm they've been split across several User IDs.
- [Profiles that don't join across devices: confirm the problem](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/data-assistant-user-solutions/cross-device-identity-audit): Confirm by hand whether the same signed-in account shows up as one Amplitude user across web and mobile.
- [Planned events that never arrived: confirm the problem](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/data-assistant-user-solutions/planned-unseen-events-audit): Compare your tracking plan with observed data and your planning records to find planned events that never reached Amplitude.
- [Failures you can't see: confirm the coverage gap](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/data-assistant-user-solutions/error-event-coverage-audit): Compare critical product journeys with your tracking plan to find failures that analytics can't observe.
- [No activation event: choose and validate one](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/data-assistant-user-solutions/activation-event-audit): Define the first meaningful value a new person reaches, then check whether an existing event already represents it.
- [Missing or mistimed exposure: confirm the problem](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/data-assistant-user-solutions/experiment-exposure-audit): Use Experiment diagnostics and user timelines to confirm exposure events fire when people actually encounter a variant.
- [No account-level analysis: decide whether you need groups](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/data-assistant-user-solutions/group-types-audit): Decide whether your account-level questions actually need Amplitude group types and the Accounts add-on.
- [Missing shared context: confirm the coverage gap](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/data/data-assistant-user-solutions/shared-properties-audit): Define the context important events should share, then use the tracking plan and Observe to find where it's missing.

## Analytics

- [Pruning and ordering of data in Amplitude Analytics](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/charts/prune-and-order-data): Learn how Amplitude Analytics prunes and orders chart data when group-bys return many values.
- [About segments](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/segments/about-segments): Segments in Amplitude are reusable filters that narrow a chart to users, sessions, or events based on properties or behavior. Learn how segment scope works.
- [Segments and cohorts](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/segments/segments-and-cohorts): Understand when to use an Amplitude segment versus a cohort, and how to convert a saved segment into a cohort that stays in sync with the segment definition.
- [Identify users with similar behaviors](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/behavioral-cohorts): A behavioral cohort groups users by the actions they take in your product, so you can segment by observed behavior rather than predicted intent.
- [Historical Count, part 1: Track user behavior for different instances of each user action](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/historical-count-1): Analyze the Nth time users perform an event in Amplitude.
- [Historical Count, part 2: Order of operations](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/historical-count-2): How Amplitude's Historical Count filter interacts with other filters, custom events, and Event Historical Count in the chart order of operations.
- [Historical Count, part 3: Funnels and behavioral cohorts](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/historical-count-3): How Historical Count filters resolve inside Funnel Analysis charts and behavioral cohorts, including the conversion-window rule and Cohort Builder limits on "Any Event".
- [Predictive analytics overview](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/predictive/predictive-analytics): Use predictions and recommendations to segment users by future behavior and personalize their experience.
- [Predictions: Use Amplitude's AI to help maximize lift](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/predictive/predictions): Understand how Amplitude predictions segment users by their likelihood to take a future action, who should use them, and how they work.
- [Recommendations: Help users reach the goals you've set for them](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/predictive/recommendations): Understand how Amplitude recommendations use AutoML to place the items most likely to help users reach a goal, including best uses and data requirements.
- [Workspace: Find your charts and track your work](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/workspace): Find your saved and draft Amplitude analyses in your personal workspace, open them quickly, and filter by content type.
- [Account-level reporting in Amplitude](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/analytics/account-level-reporting): Report on accounts, organizations, or other aggregated units instead of individual users.

## Amplitude AI

- [Global Agent Overview](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai/global-agent-overview): Use Global Agent to analyze Amplitude data, create charts, edit dashboards, and answer product analytics questions.
- [Agent Modes](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai/agent-modes): Choose Fast, Default, or Investigate mode based on the depth and speed your Global Agent question requires.
- [Agent Skills](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai/agent-skills): Create reusable instruction sets that the Global Agent applies automatically when your request matches a skill's description.
- [Specialized Agents Overview](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai/specialized-agents-overview): Run purpose-built agents on a schedule to deliver opportunities to your inbox, email, or Slack.
- [Agent Analytics Overview](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai/agent-analytics/overview): Measure and improve the AI agents you build for your users. Connect agent quality to retention, conversion, and revenue.
- [Track AI assistant conversations, token cost, latency, and feedback](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai/agent-analytics/setup): Instrument an AI assistant or LLM agent to track conversations, token usage, cost, latency, model, and user feedback in Amplitude Agent Analytics with the AI SDK, OpenTelemetry, or the HTTP API.
- [Agent Analytics sessions and user identity](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai/agent-analytics/sessions): How Agent Analytics groups agent events into sessions, which session ID to pass, how and when sessions close, and how to send user IDs so one person stays one user.
- [Agent Analytics privacy modes](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai/agent-analytics/privacy-modes): Compare the three Agent Analytics privacy modes (full, metadata_only, customer_enriched), what each one sends to Amplitude, and how to choose one before rollout.
- [Import agent conversations from other tools](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai/agent-analytics/integrations): Get agent conversations into Agent Analytics from a data warehouse, an LLM tracing tool, a hosted agent or voice platform, a coding agent, an agent framework, an AI gateway, or a local model, and compare what each path captures.
- [MCP Analytics](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai/mcp-analytics): Connect activity on your Model Context Protocol server to your product data in Amplitude to find what users ask your tools for and whether they get it. Status: Early Access.
- [AI Visibility](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai/ai-visibility): Measure your brand presence in AI-generated answers and use recommendations to improve AI search visibility.
- [AI Feedback](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/amplitude-ai/ai-feedback): Combine customer feedback with product behavior to surface AI-grouped insights and actions.

## Wave

- [Wave](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/wave): Wave is Amplitude's team of proactive AI agents for discovering and prioritizing product improvements. Learn how Wave connects evidence to recommendations aligned with your goals.
- [Create a Product Area](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/wave/product-areas): A Product Area is the persistent context that focuses Amplitude Opportunities on one part of your product. Learn what a Product Area contains and how to create one.
- [Connect context to Wave](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/wave/connecting-context): Opportunities are only as good as the signal behind them. Learn which insight sources power discovery and how connecting your codebase sharpens recommendations.
- [Connect Jira and Linear to Wave](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/wave/connect-issue-trackers): Connect Jira or Linear to Wave so you can create issues from opportunities and Wave can tell when linked work is done.
- [Connect Slack to Wave](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/wave/connect-slack): Choose the Slack channels Wave listens to for opportunity signals in a Product Area, and control whether Wave replies in Slack threads.
- [Anatomy and lifecycle of an opportunity](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/wave/opportunities): Learn what a Wave opportunity contains, how Reach × Impact determines its priority, and how it moves through review, execution, and measurement.
- [The opportunity graph and product map](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/wave/opportunity-graph): Opportunities aren't a flat backlog. They live in a graph that connects work to evidence, metrics, pull requests, and the screens and flows in your product map.
- [Act on an opportunity](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/wave/acting-on-opportunities): Move an Opportunity forward: in the Amplitude UI or agent-natively through the Amplitude MCP server in Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex.
- [Amplitude coding agent](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/wave/amplitude-coding-agent): How Amplitude secures GitHub access, code indexing, and coding agents for Wave Opportunities, including sandbox isolation and what Amplitude stores.
- [Tune Wave discovery](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/wave/tuning-opportunities): Learn how to tune Product Areas and Opportunities so recommendations align with your Product Area goals, preferred work style, and quality bar.
- [Memories and skills in Wave](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/wave/memories-and-skills): Review the preferences Wave remembers about a Product Area, and give Wave reusable skills for tasks your team does often.
- [Manage Product Areas](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/wave/manage-product-areas): Change a Product Area's investigation schedule, owner, and output language, subscribe to it, archive it, and check your workspace limits.

## Session Replay

- [Understand Session Replay](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/session-replay/overview): Watch real user sessions to find the why behind your product metrics and conversion drops.
- [Install Session Replay](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/session-replay/instrument-session-replay): Install Session Replay with your platform's Unified SDK, configure capture, and verify your first recording.
- [Choose a session matching option](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/session-replay/session-matching): Link replays to Amplitude sessions so you can move between qualitative and quantitative views.
- [Configure custom session matching](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/session-replay/configure-custom-session-matching): Match replays to a custom session-defining event property in your Amplitude project.
- [Configure time-based matching](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/session-replay/configure-time-based-matching): Match replays to analytics events using device IDs and 30- or 60-minute time windows.
- [Verify Session Replay capture](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/session-replay/verify-capture): Check a test replay, event association, and masking before capturing production sessions with Session Replay.
- [Monitor replays continuously with an agent](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/session-replay/monitor-replays-with-an-agent): Learn how the Session Replay Agent reviews replays on a schedule to surface friction, drop-offs, and engagement patterns that manual review misses.
- [Find session replays](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/session-replay/find-replays): Find a session replay with search, a chart, User Look-Up, or your Amplitude homepage.
- [Watch a session replay](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/session-replay/session-replay-viewer): Watch a user's session with playback controls and a synchronized event timeline in the Session Replay viewer.
- [Inspect errors in a session replay](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/session-replay/inspect-replay-errors): Correlate user actions with console logs, JavaScript errors, and network requests in a session replay.
- [Identify user friction with Friction Monitor](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/session-replay/friction-monitor): Detect, rank, and route the UX friction issues with the greatest impact using Autocapture data and session replays. Status: Early Access.
- [Self-host Session Replay SDKs](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/session-replay/session-replay-self-hosting): Host Amplitude SDK files and proxy API calls from your own domain to bypass ad blockers and meet data residency requirements.

## Zoning Insights

- [Zoning Insights](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/zoning-insights): Zoning Insights measures click, exposure, and scroll metrics for named zones you draw on your pages.
- [Zoning Insights Instrumentation](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/zoning-insights/instrumentation): Instrument Zoning Insights using the Amplitude Browser SDK, Google Tag Manager, Tealium iQ, or Segment.
- [Comparing Overlays](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/zoning-insights/comparing-overlays): Compare two overlays side by side to identify how zone behavior differs between pages, segments, or points in time

## Heatmaps

- [Heatmaps vs. Session Replay](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/heatmaps/heatmaps-vs-session-replay): Compare Heatmaps, Session Replay, and Zoning Insights, and pick the one that answers the question you're asking about a page.
- [Heatmap use cases](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/heatmaps/use-cases): Learn how to apply click, selector, and scroll maps to optimize conversion, validate redesigns, and compare behavior across segments and devices.
- [Create a heatmap](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/heatmaps/create-a-heatmap): Review the prerequisites for Heatmaps, then create a heatmap and target the pages and users you want to analyze.
- [Troubleshoot Heatmaps](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/heatmaps/troubleshooting): Resolve common Heatmaps issues, including blank heatmaps, missing data, incorrect backgrounds, and organization availability.

## Guides and Surveys

- [Get Started](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/guides-and-surveys/get-started): Install an SDK to start with Guides and Surveys, then use the Overview tab to track guide and survey engagement across your apps.
- [Overview](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/guides-and-surveys/overview): Get a high-level look at how Guides and Surveys works inside your product.
- [Proxy requests to Guides and Surveys](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/guides-and-surveys/proxy): Reverse-proxy Guides and Surveys assets and APIs through your own domain or CDN.
- [Overview](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/guides-and-surveys/guide-overview): See how you can use guides, and the templates available to you.
- [Overview](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/guides-and-surveys/survey-overview): Learn how surveys can improve the feedback you get from your users, and preview the available templates.
- [Build a Survey](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/guides-and-surveys/build-a-survey): See what goes in to building a survey, and how they differ from guides.
- [Analyze a Survey](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/guides-and-surveys/analyze-a-survey): Explore the options available to you as you analyze survey results.
- [Hosted Surveys](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/guides-and-surveys/hosted-surveys): Share a survey through a standalone, Amplitude-hosted link instead of embedding it in your app.
- [Setup and Targeting](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/guides-and-surveys/setup-and-target): How targeting and triggers control who sees a guide or survey, and when and where it appears.
- [Experiments](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/guides-and-surveys/experiments): Run A/B and multi-armed bandit experiments on your guides and surveys with Amplitude Experiment to compare variants and ship the version that performs best.
- [Testing and Publishing](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/guides-and-surveys/testing): Test your guides and surveys in Preview mode or Testing status, then publish them to your users.
- [Mobile Guides and Surveys](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/guides-and-surveys/mobile-guides-and-surveys): How mobile guides and surveys differ from web: supported form factors, survey blocks, web-only settings, and SDK version requirements.

## Web Experiment

- [Set up a web experiment](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/web-experiment/set-up-a-web-experiment): Use the Visual Editor to launch an A/B or multi-armed bandit experiment without writing code.
- [Implement Web Experiment](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/web-experiment/implementation): Install the Web Experiment script in your site so variants render before the page paints.
- [Cookies and consent management (Web Experiment)](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/web-experiment/cookies-and-consent-management): Gate the Web Experiment script on cookie consent so experiments run without writing to the device until the visitor consents.
- [Web Experiment event tracking](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/web-experiment/tracking): Track impression events through Web Experiment to power analysis and billing.
- [Post-experiment steps](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/web-experiment/post-experiment): Move winning variants into your production code rather than running 100% allocations indefinitely.
- [Proxy Web Experiment](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/web-experiment/proxy): Proxy Web Experiment scripts through your own infrastructure for security and privacy control.

## Feature Experiment

- [Overview](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/feature-experiment/overview): Amplitude Experiment runs feature flag rollouts, A/B tests, and web experiments so teams can validate product changes before rolling them out broadly.
- [Experiment Quick Start](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/feature-experiment/experiment-quick-start): Stand up your first experiment quickly with a workflow-based path through Amplitude Experiment.
- [Value calculation in Experiment Analysis charts](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/feature-experiment/under-the-hood/experiment-analysis-chart-calculation): Understand the inputs and formulas Amplitude uses to calculate values in Experiment Analysis charts, with funnel and retention examples.
- [The cumulative exposures graph: Increasing and decreasing slopes](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/feature-experiment/advanced-techniques/cumulative-exposure-change-slope): Interpret increasing and decreasing slopes on an Amplitude Experiment cumulative exposures graph, including hourly views and static cohort effects.
- [The cumulative exposures graph: Divergent lines](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/feature-experiment/advanced-techniques/cumulative-exposure-divergent-lines): Understand divergent lines on an Amplitude Experiment cumulative exposures graph, whether the slopes are similar or different, and what causes them.
- [The cumulative exposures graph: Inflection points and flattened slopes](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/feature-experiment/advanced-techniques/cumulative-exposure-inflection-points): Read inflection points and flattened slopes on an Amplitude Experiment cumulative exposures graph, and learn what causes each pattern.
- [Event tracking](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/feature-experiment/under-the-hood/event-tracking): Learn how Experiment assignment and exposure events support analysis.
- [Experiment Evaluation](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/feature-experiment/implementation): Learn how to implement Amplitude Experiment in your product.
- [Local evaluation](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/feature-experiment/local-evaluation): Learn how local evaluation runs Amplitude Experiment logic inside the SDK to avoid network requests, and how its targeting compares to remote evaluation.
- [Remote evaluation](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/feature-experiment/remote-evaluation): Learn how remote evaluation fetches variants from Amplitude Experiment's evaluation servers, including targeting capabilities and Amplitude ID resolution.
- [Sticky bucketing](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/feature-experiment/advanced-techniques/sticky-bucketing): Learn how sticky bucketing keeps users in their original experiment variants, when to enable it, and how to verify it for a specific user.
- [Bonferroni Correction](https://amplitude.com/docs/api/content/feature-experiment/advanced-techniques/bonferroni-correction): Learn how the Bonferroni correction in Amplitude Experiment adjusts for the multiple comparisons problem when you test several variants or metrics.
